plugins.name: fsnotes
plugins.description: Search, create, edit, and delete notes managed by the FSNotes macOS app via natural requests.

plugins.name: gh-lookup
plugins.description: Look up exact `gh` CLI command and flag syntax — and discover whether a `gh` command exists for a task — from the locally installed reference.
